scope_review: Original accounting system/control architecture. No specific recognition, measurement, disclosure or statutory quantitative threshold asserted. Framework requirements are conditional referrals to technical topics. SEC/PCAOB footer identifies applicable control/auditor context without mandating architecture; NIST voluntary use verified on its official overview, 2026-10-01. Operational must statements are design acceptance criteria, not new GAAP.

accuracy_checks.challenge: Wrong revenue mapping fails even when the aggregate trial balance balances; July 1 change must preserve earlier reports.
accuracy_checks.reason: 300,000 deposits plus 500,000 deferred balances = 800,000; merged account must retain distinct obligations and historical dimensions.

period_and_scope_check: Architecture is framework-neutral; framework, legal entity, currency and transaction date gate the actual policy implemented. Existing effective-dated mappings retained. NIST AI RMF is voluntary; revision in progress does not prescribe accounting.
cross_framework_check: Same reconciled architecture can implement different IFRS, US GAAP, UK and AU policies. No inference of identical recognition or measurement; issuer ICFR and integrated-auditor responsibilities are separate.
numerical_reperformance: 300,000 deposits plus 500,000 deferred balances = 800,000; merged account must retain distinct obligations and historical dimensions.
cross_topic_check: Consistent with approved close/control topics: no plugs, gross exception review, retained ownership, complete populations before match rate, accounting approval before automated posting.
rights_check: Original design guidance, no restricted authoritative text. NIST overview https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework checked; limited voluntary-status paraphrase.
review_basis: Claim propositions and relevant guidance, framework/period gates, worked examples and boundary cases were individually challenged in the findings below. artifact_scope is the topic inventory, not a claim that every historical line or authority link was independently source-verified.
